menu_data.archive_policy: ZIP must contain only menus/**/*.xml files; total uncompressed payload <= 64 MiB, each XML <= 4 MiB and compression ratio <= 200; traversal, backslashes, symlinks and invalid ZIP structure are rejected.
menu_data.privacy: Private menu archives and extracted XML are local-only and are not committed.
